name: Parapengornis
sum: Large pengornithid from the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning with many slender, recurved teeth.
holotype: IVPP V18687, a nearly complete articulated skeleton from the Jiufotang Formation near Lingyuan, western Liaoning.
material: The holotype and a nearly complete specimen formerly referred to Pengornis.
biology: Its many slender, pointed and recurved teeth distinguish it from other pengornithids.
author: Hu et al. 2015
